name: Black Grimoire: Odyssey
desc:
BGO is a procedurally generated dungeon crawler game inspired by Pixel Dungeon, Soul Knight, Black Clover, and many other games/series.
The game is still in work and will get updated often. I'm the only one working on it so forgive me if there are errors, bugs or if there is no content at all.
Expect shutdowns.

Join the group for in-game perks:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/3885445/NikkiDZN

Controls:
M/Start/Level Button - Open menu
G/ButtonA - Interact
Z and X/DPadUp and DPadDown - Scroll between spells
To run you simply walk.

Chances: 
Drop Chance: Common-40%, Uncommon-25%, Rare-15%, Epic-10%, Legendary-8%, Mythical-2%
Rank Chance: E-30%, D-25%, C-17%, B-13%, A-10%, S-5%

Voices:
Adam Ca
Gina Or
Phil Fr
Ral V

Compositor:
João Mu

Some contributions by naaccz

If you have any issue with the assets used in the game contact me!

scripts.title: Auto Attack And More
scripts.features:
🔹 Auto Attack: Say farewell to repetitive clicking! Our Script automates your attacks, allowing you to focus on strategizing and exploring the vast realms of Black Grimoire: Odyssey. Unleash your powers and defeat enemies with ease!

🔹 Bring Monsters: Tired of searching for monsters to battle? Our Script has you covered. With a simple command, you can summon monsters to your location, ensuring that you're always engaged in thrilling battles and reaping the rewards.

🔹 Upgrade Damage: Maximize your strength and become unstoppable! Our Script assists you in upgrading your damage, empowering your attacks and making you a formidable force. Crush your enemies and conquer the darkest corners of the realm!

🔹 And More: Our Script is filled with additional features to enrich your gameplay. From resource management to cooldown reduction, we've got you covered. Unleash your full potential and overcome any challenge that comes your way!

🔹UGC: https://www.roblox.com/catalog/17390320383/Charlie-Pellet-II
